name: Vuz'ka brama
source: In the middle of an abandoned city with a radio receiver. It is dangerous to stay and the way of salvation is doubtful. You will meet three people on the way - will they be able to help? An unfamiliar world surrounded by a solid desert. Should you run from him or did you run from the other?
translation: 你帶著一臺收音機，置身於一座廢棄城市的中央。留在這裡很危險，逃生之路也前途未卜。途中你會遇見三個人，他們能幫上忙嗎？陌生的世界被無邊沙漠包圍。你該逃離他，還是逃離另一個人？
